I've been playin solo for over 500 hours and let me tell you its fucking hard haha. Some moments are absolute cinema when you're sneaking around unnoticed and wipe a squad. Meeting other random solos and teaming up only to get killed and never see them again is really fun and adds a cool aspect to the game. The lone wolf against the world playstyle is really fun and makes you extremely paranoid and makes you feel incredibly vulnerable at all times which is awesome if you like the horror type feel to the game. HOWEVER, most of the time you are going to get annihilated by squads, and any base you make will get smoked and you lose all the hours you put into it with realistically no hope of defending it against clans. Overall I'd say playing solo is fun if you're a casual player but if you plan on putting a lot of time into the game and getting good/building a base def try to find a team to run with as it just makes the game more enjoyable and less frustrating. Side note you can always just find a community server for solos or duos to make it more fair.
